name: defi-dungeons-verse
description: A real-time Aavegotchi dungeon world with multiplayer movement, combat, loot, progression, and DeFi rewards

scripts.generate:shared: pnpm run generate:floors && pnpm --filter @gotchiverse/server exec node --import tsx ../../scripts/generate-shared-files.ts
scripts.prebuild: pnpm run generate:dialogues && pnpm run generate:shared
scripts.build:server: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run generate:shared && turbo build --filter=@gotchiverse/server && cp -r apps/server/dist/* .
scripts.pre-dev: echo '🔧 Server is self-contained, no separate packages to build'
scripts.dev:local: pnpm stop && sleep 1 && pnpm clean:stale && pnpm run generate:shared && turbo dev
scripts.stop: pkill -f 'turbo.*dev' || true && pkill -f 'next dev' || true && pkill -f 'tsx watch' || true && pkill -f 'typescript.*tsc.*watch' || true && lsof -ti:3001 | xargs kill -9 || true && lsof -ti:1999 | xargs kill -9 || true
